info.title: InvestiTrack Document Management
info.description: Private immutable object versions, quarantine and signed worker callbacks. Version/association collections return items. Search returns only available documents in the current authorized scope. Previews and thumbnails are unsupported. Idempotency-Key replays the original response; If-Match is one quoted aggregate ETag. Scan callbacks require HMAC-SHA256 of the exact UTF-8 body in X-Result-Signature. Bodies and storage keys never appear in public metadata.

get.description: Requires document-service audience, an allowlisted client_id and the route-specific document:* scope. Context: identity-service; scan: malware-scanner; extraction: text-extractor; index/source: ai-service; references/holds: project-execution-service (or project-service). Source validation, reference validation and hold creation require a delegated user_id claim. Other operations require workload sub=client_id.
